title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency: Rate Schedule for Re-Charged Days
content:
**Finance office clarification, resumed months — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** The re-charge schedule follows the agreement's rate notice, the notice period being 60 days and the current schedule effective 1 July 2026.

1. Where the notice had not run its 60 days by the first day of the advance's span but had run them by the conversion date recorded on the agreement, that date falling on or after 1 July 2026: the current private pay schedule.
2. Where a rate notice delivery date is recorded and the notice had not run its 60 days by the conversion date recorded on the agreement: the preceding schedule.
3. In any other case: the schedule in effect for the agreement on the first day of the advance's span — current once the notice had run its 60 days by that day and the span begins on or after 1 July 2026, preceding otherwise.

| Accommodation tier | Preceding schedule (effective 1 July 2025), USD per day | Current schedule (effective 1 July 2026), USD per day |
|---|---|---|
| Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | 384.00 | 398.00 |
| Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | 412.00 | 427.00 |
| Private Long-Term Care Room | 421.00 | 436.00 |
| Private Secure Memory Care Room | 449.00 | 465.00 |
| Private Bariatric Care Room | 466.00 | 482.00 |
| Private Suite with Sitting Area | 497.00 | 514.00 |

**Points of judgement (hypothetical).** Notice delivered 40 days before the recorded conversion date: rule 2, preceding. Notice delivered 90 days before an advance beginning after 1 July 2026: rule 3, current. No notice recorded: rule 3, preceding.
